### NumberField.Root

<ParamField body="Root.allowOutOfRange" type="boolean" default="false">
  Allows typed, pasted, and autofilled values outside min and max. Native range validation still applies; step interactions remain bounded.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.allowWheelScrub" type="boolean" default="false">
  Allows wheel adjustments while the visible input is focused and hovered. Defaults to false.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.children" type="ReactNode">
  Composed NumberField parts and supporting content.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.className" type="string | ((state: NumberFieldRootState) =&gt; string | undefined)">
  Class applied to this part, or a callback receiving its NumberField state.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.defaultValue" type="number" default="empty">
  Initial uncontrolled number. Omit to start empty; the public type accepts a number.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.disabled" type="boolean" default="false">
  Prevents interaction and excludes the value from form submission.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.form" type="string">
  ID of the form owning the hidden native number input.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.format" type="NumberFormatOptions">
  Intl.NumberFormat options for display and parsing, including currency, units, percent, grouping, and precision. Explicit rounding options can normalize the committed value on blur.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.id" type="string">
  ID associated with the visible input. Generated when omitted.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.inputRef" type="Ref&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;">
  Ref to the hidden native number input used for submission and validation. Use Input.ref to focus the visible text input.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.largeStep" type="number" default="10">
  Amount used while Shift is held. Defaults to 10.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.locale" type="LocalesArgument">
  Locale or locale list used to format and parse numbers. Defaults to the runtime locale.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.max" type="number">
  Inclusive maximum for stepping and native range validation.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.min" type="number">
  Inclusive minimum for stepping and native range validation.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.name" type="string">
  Name of the raw numeric value submitted by the hidden input.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.onValueChange" type="((value: number | null, eventDetails: NumberFieldRootChangeEventDetails) =&gt; void)">
  Receives the next number or null and change details with the native event, reason, cancellation and propagation methods, and optional stepping direction.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.onValueCommitted" type="((value: number | null, eventDetails: NumberFieldRootCommitEventDetails) =&gt; void)">
  Receives the committed number or null and generic details containing event and reason. Typing commits on blur; pointer steps and scrubbing commit on release; keyboard and wheel changes commit immediately.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.readOnly" type="boolean" default="false">
  Prevents changes while keeping the visible input focusable.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.ref" type="Ref&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;">
  Ref to the root div, or the element composed through Root.render.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, NumberFieldRootState&gt;">
  Composes this part with an element or render callback. Forward the supplied props and ref to the corresponding DOM element.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.required" type="boolean" default="false">
  Requires a numeric value for native form submission.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.smallStep" type="number" default="0.1">
  Amount used while Alt is held. Defaults to 0.1.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.snapOnStep" type="boolean" default="false">
  Snaps step interactions to multiples of the active step. Defaults to false.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.step" type="number | &quot;any&quot;" default="1">
  Base amount for buttons, arrow keys, wheel, and scrubbing. Use any to disable native step validation while stepping by 1.
